parts:
Thank you.

2013/4/12 Graham Williams <Graham....@togaware.com>
You can resize the window itself and the tree should rescale.

Or have a look in the Log tab and note the rattle command used to draw the tree:

fancyRpartPlot(crs$rpart, main="Decision Tree weather.csv $ RainTomorrow")

Then in the R console, open a new device of the size you want, and run the command:

> dev.new(width=10, height=8)
> fancyRpartPlot(crs$rpart, main="Decision Tree weather.csv $ RainTomorrow")


Graham Williams
http://togaware.com
